verdict.rationale: Stripe documents stablecoin payouts to connected accounts via Connect (docs-8, docs-9, docs-23), which lets a platform disburse stablecoins to many recipients, but there is no documented batch/bulk payout endpoint or per-item status reporting mechanism, and community evidence notes restrictions (crypto payouts limited to individuals/sole proprietors, not companies) that constrain use for true mass disbursement. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch payout API documentation, per-item status/reporting semantics, support for paying company/non-profit recipients.
